Chapter 1179: Chapter 3 The Fusion of the Root Source (Subscribe)_2

Thirteen-stage lifeforms can see through future timelines and choose a predetermined timeline to follow. However, during this, they might be affected by the interference of other thirteen-stage lifeforms.

The dimensional gap that Xuanhuang experienced was the handiwork of two time beings, possibly acting at a pivotal time node to create the future they desired.

For time beings, all existences below the thirteen-stage are mere pawns. Only time beings of the same level are adversaries, they are the players.

...

Internal universe.

Apart from contemplating the Sky Void Tripod, Lin Yuan also sent a strand of his consciousness to descend into his internal universe.

"The Origin objects of these mysterious lands..."

Lin Yuan looked at the Life Origin Stone, the primal ore crystal, the Nine Heavens Thunder Core, and so on, floating before him.

"Consult the senior, see if they can be integrated into the internal universe."

With a slight shift of mind, Lin Yuan appeared beside the jade gourd and took out more than ten Origin objects.

When obtaining these Origin objects, Lin Yuan had already thought of integrating them into his internal universe.

But in the end, he decided to consult the opinion of the red-clad girl.

After all, she was created by a thirteen-stage time being, specifically to guide the "Infinite Void," a thirteen-stage legacy.

Through contemplating the Sky Void Tripod, Lin Yuan gained a clear understanding of the mighty power of thirteen-stage beings, realizing more of his insignificance.

"These?"

The red-clad girl, upon seeing more than ten Origin objects, immediately widened her eyes.

Origin objects are the fundamentals of a mysterious land, and the spirits of those lands would never willingly throw them out.

Even an Invincible Great Saint spanning an era would find it challenging to obtain an Origin object. The Life Origin Stone obtained by Xuanhuang was not through normal means but ’stolen’ at some opportune moment.

"What exactly did you do for those guys to hand over so many Origin objects?"

The red-clad girl was incredulous. Over long eras, previous cultivators of the "Infinite Void" have reached the level of the Invincible Great Saint.

Naturally, they visited many mysterious lands but dared not overly pressure the spirits of those lands.

After all, if they pushed too far, the spirits would surely seek help from time beings behind them, and no one at the twelfth layer could bear such consequences, not even the Invincible Great Saint who inherits the thirteen-stage legacy.

To get them to hand over these Origin objects willingly, unless there is a tremendous background that isn’t afraid of the threats from thirteen-stage time beings, but if there were such a vast backing, those Origin objects wouldn’t even matter.

"Just a fluke..." Lin Yuan said.

Now, he roughly knew how Xuanhuang managed to meet those ’old friends.’

If Xuanhuang was destined to perish, forcefully entering mysterious lands, naturally they wouldn’t care about thirteen-stage time beings.

After all, they were destined to die.

"Can they be integrated into the internal universe?"

Lin Yuan immediately inquired.

This was also his most concerning question.

"Yes."

"Of course, they can."

The red-clad girl immediately jumped up, "For other Chaos Realm perfect beings, integrating these Origin objects into their internal universe means little, at most forming environments similar to those mysterious lands."

"Because their internal universe’s limit has been fixed, unable to bring out the potential of these Origin objects."

The red-clad girl looked at Lin Yuan, "But you are different, your internal universe is evolving towards the Chaos Void. Preemptively nurturing these Origin objects to form mysterious lands, naturally has great benefits, tremendous benefits."

The red-clad girl clicked her tongue in wonder, "Originally, I planned to wait until you reached the perfection of the Chaos Realm or possessed the strength of the Invincible Great Saint to attempt to obtain those Origin objects from the mysterious lands."

"With your strength, once reaching the perfection of the Chaos Realm, you should surpass the normal Invincible Great Saint. By then, visiting those mysterious lands, combined with coercion and inducement, has a good chance of success."

"But now..."

The red-clad girl looked at the Origin objects before her.

She felt she had underestimated Lin Yuan, and there was no need to wait for the chaos realm’s perfection.

"Since that’s the case, I’ll start integrating."

Lin Yuan immediately said. Unlike the fusion of the Fierce Sun origin, the latter was Lin Yuan’s Divine Skill, which could be halted and dissipated at any time.

But these Origin objects, after all, belong to external objects, so one must think more before integrating and devouring them.

"Go ahead."

The red-clad girl nodded, looking at Lin Yuan, "I’m now more and more curious about what level your internal universe will grow to and whether it can reach the theoretical seventh layer...

"The seventh layer of ’Infinite Void’?"

Lin Yuan contemplated. According to the creator of this legacy, the time being, the internal universe nurtured at the seventh layer of ’Infinite Void’ would rival the Chaos Void, perhaps standing on par with thirteen-stage time beings in terms of the internal universe?

Of course, this parity is limited to the internal universe.

...

The internal universe was vast and mighty.

After achieving the Ninth Realm in space-time perception, Lin Yuan’s internal universe ushered in another wave of rapid expansion.

From a diameter of a trillion light-years, it directly surged to an eighteen trillion light-year circumference.

It’s important to know, Lin Yuan’s internal universe never prioritized size or area, but rather the level of quality.

A universe spanning a trillion light-years is sufficient to shake those internal universes expanding billions and trillions of light-years.

Now reaching eighteen trillion light-years, the magnitude of foundational enhancement is self-evident.

"Integrate."

Lin Yuan took out the Life Origin Stone.

The Life Origin Stone, only the size of a fist, yet faintly brimming with the essence of life, as vast as an ocean.

Whoosh.

The Life Origin Stone was thrown by Lin Yuan, and then immediately engulfed and fused by the cosmic origin.

Whoosh.

After fusing and devouring the external Life Origin Stone, Lin Yuan faintly sensed mastering a thread of the most fundamental force of life.

"Converge."

Lin Yuan’s thought moved.

That thread of the most fundamental force of life began to spread, faintly forming a ’pond’ composed entirely of life essence.

Lin Yuan overlooked that small pond, "The mysterious land ’Sea of Life’ is vast and enormous, yet now I form... a small pond with its Origin object?"

Lin Yuan didn’t find it surprising. The Sea of Life was left by a thirteen-stage time being, and Lin Yuan, not being a time being, nurturing a mysterious land with the Life Origin Stone would naturally fall far short of the former.

Of course, this falling short is only temporary.

With Lin Yuan’s strength enhancement and continuous evolution of the internal universe, the ’mysterious lands’ nurtured will constantly grow.

Following this.

Lin Yuan similarly integrated the primal ore crystal and Nine Heavens Thunder Core into his internal universe.

Various Origin objects constantly evolved within Lin Yuan’s internal universe, forming ’miniature’ mysterious lands one after another.

"Void Golden Leaf?"

Lin Yuan looked at the last Origin object.

This Origin object came from a mysterious land named the Void Divine Tree, being its core leaf, giving Lin Yuan a feeling akin to observing the Chaos Void.

"It’s said that the Void Divine Tree reaches the heavens and the earth, a single leaf is as big as a Void Domain, and this Void Golden Leaf is a leaf from the tree’s crown, never touched by any supreme Great Saint in history, nor has any related information or intelligence ever emerged."

Lin Yuan pondered silently.

The Origin objects given by Xuanhuang, Lin Yuan eventually chose to integrate all into his internal universe, not only for the most direct and profound personal enhancement.

Another reason was not knowing the utility of these Origin objects?

Trading?

Even a supreme Great Saint would find it challenging to afford a cost sufficient to exchange for such Origin objects.

Moreover, if Lin Yuan rashly exposed that he possessed these Origin objects, it would also attract numerous troubles.

"Directly integrate."

Lin Yuan tossed the Void Golden Leaf, and a vast amount of cosmic origin power swept forth.

The Void Golden Leaf was quickly fused and consumed, with strands of infinite spatial golden power immediately spreading throughout the whole universe.
